note: Time budgets per named machine (machines.json), read by tests through budget(key) from @aethervtt/shard-core/test-env (spec 0075). Milliseconds unless an entry says otherwise with `in` (frames, ratio). Kinds: target (what the product wants), unit (cost per `per`, times the test's count), rate (`per` a second, a floor), guard (a measured value; the limit is value × (1 + margin), and pnpm bench --ratchet proposes lowering it when a run beats it by more than twice its margin). Every entry has a note: a change to a number is a diff with a reason.

gpu:foliage.note: 0045: 2.2M grass blades in view within 60 m at 960×540, GPU frame with the layer minus without (median). 3 ms is 0045's number, not measured on the desktop. The laptop measured about 18 ms (2026-10-07): about half vertex work (12M vertices through the material's hooks) and half shading on overlapping blades; it was 70 ms before LODs and nearest-cascade shadows. Leads: compute each visible instance's transform once in the cull pass, and a simpler material for the farthest level. Full density with no target: the regression measure. In an app, foliage now adapts to its scatter-walk slice instead (FoliageBudget, 0075 part B; scatter/src/scenario.test.ts). scatter/src/bench.test.ts.

structure/cutaway.note: 0070: GPU frame with 16 reveal points over none on the max fixture at 1280×720 (median of interleaved rounds); 0070 asks for +5%. The laptop measured +8–11% (2026-10-04), not measured on the desktop. With the points cutting nothing it's +1%; the rest is the cut chunks: a discard costs a tiled GPU its hidden-surface removal, so what's behind a cut wall is shaded too. Drawing those batches last didn't change it. Lead: draw the cut batches depth-only first, then everything at depthCompare 'equal' (needs @invariant clip positions in the core shaders). structure/src/cutaway.test.ts.

scatter-walk.what: star-explorer's planet, walking through forest with grass
scatter-walk.note: Proposed split, awaiting measurement on both machines (spec 0075 sets splits from measurements). Keys cover the spans the walk records (scatter/src/scenario.test.ts), none twice. GPU: gpu:forward-opaque (terrain, rocks, bushes and trees draw there), gpu:foliage (foliage/place, /cull and its own /draw pass; FoliageBudget's default target), gpu:shadows (cascade0-3), gpu:tonemap; terrain/generate (the old gpu:terrain, only while chunks generate), instance-cull and light-clusters fall in headroom. CPU: render (every render system and render/<node> encode, terrain/encode included), scatter (scatter/props), terrain/select, terrain/planets.
